hypothesis.statement: Nested tagged classification plus metadata-first progressive loading improves top-k capability retrieval quality and verified task success while reducing context ingestion and unnecessary tool/schema loads, compared with flat tags and broad definition loading.
hypothesis.predeclared_threshold: Progressive treatment reduces definition bytes loaded by at least 40% while maintaining top-5 relevant-and-safe retrieval precision within 0.05 of the broad-load baseline; final success and permission guardrails remain non-inferior.
hypothesis.null: The nested metadata-first approach yields zero material improvement in retrieval quality or context cost under the fixed task cohort.

design.unit_of_observation: one fixed capability-search task executed under one treatment and one pinned configured instance; each completed run emits one EXPERIMENT record

fixed_controls.retrieval_engine: SQLite FTS5 BM25; LIKE fallback is a separately recorded environment condition
fixed_controls.deduplication: canonical source locator + package/skill/action identity + content SHA-256
fixed_controls.trust_policy: vendor/community/session inputs remain distinct trust strata; permission gates identical across all arms
fixed_controls.catalog_freshness: Freeze the approved session/catalog snapshot hashes for all arms; record capture time and source revision.

design.replication: 8 fixed tasks × 8 treatment arms = 64 planned observations; task-family balance and budget confirmed at admission.
design.randomization: balanced randomized assignment within task-family and difficulty blocks; preserve planned and observed allocation and report deviations.

outcomes.primary: top-5 relevant-and-safe capability retrieval precision, with selected-source correctness independently adjudicated
secondary: context bytes and actual input tokens where telemetry exists
guardrails: all outcomes retain explicit unknown/blocked/failed states

design.analysis: Estimate main effects and interactions with uncertainty; preserve per-run observations; stratify by task family/difficulty; treat latency and token reduction as resource measures and correctness as an independent outcome. Confirm promising effects on a held-out task cohort.
design.configured_instance: Pin provider and model@version; system prompt ref+sha256; tools ref+sha256; role; moniker; context; environment fingerprint; base SHA; evaluator; dataset/cohort; and instance_key.

dimension_roles.44: fixed control: canonical identity and content-hash relationship policy

automation.required: Add reviewed workflow dispatch/admission path that pins catalogs, toolset snapshots and configured-instance identity; emits one EXPERIMENT-schema record per run; preserves failed and blocked outcomes.

constraints: Use offline frozen catalog fixtures for first validation; external live catalog calls require authorized source access and budget.
External skill installation and execution stay outside the discovery indexer.
Keep credentials, private prompts, full tool schemas and completion content outside the index.
All treatment arms retain identical safety and authorization gates.
